discovered_issues.title: path_reachability_weak: backwpup REST EP findings have path_reachable=0.25
discovered_issues.root_cause_analysis: Gate check_scores show path_reachable=0.25 for most backwpup REST findings. The 'path_reachable' check requires sink evidence matched in the EP's callback body. Backwpup REST EP callbacks are often thin dispatchers — the actual sink (update_option, etc.) is in a downstream method. Phase 1 IR-02 shallow call chain resolution may not be finding these downstream sinks for REST EPs. Alternatively, the findings reference sinks in files not matched to the EP's callback chain.
discovered_issues.severity: MEDIUM — prevents UNCERTAIN→PLAUSIBLE transition for backwpup REST findings. guard_consistent improved but path_reachable bottleneck remains.
affects: backwpup REST EP findings (most of 22 UNCERTAIN)
